Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. 2. Pierce each potato several times with fork. 3. On sheet pan(s), place potatoes 1" apart. 4. Bake until fork-tender, 50 to 60 minutes. 5. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Turmeric & Quinoa Basmati Rice
Recipe.assembly_instructions: RANGE-TOP METHOD 1. In stockpot over high heat, bring water to a boil. Add rice, turmeric and cinnamon stick. Stir. Return to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. 2. Discard cinnamon stick. 3. Combine Red Quinoa and cooked basmati rice. Toss to mix. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. OVEN / STEAMER METHOD 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F or preheat steamer. FOR EACH 24 SERVINGS: 1. In 2" full steam table pan, place the following: 1 qt + 1 1/4 C boiling water 2 tsp salt 2 tsp turmeric 1 cinnamon stick 1 lb + 4 oz rice Stir. Cover. 2. Bake or steam until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 25 to 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with fork. 3. Discard cinnamon stick. 4. Combine Red Quinoa and cooked basmati rice. Toss to mix. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Roasted Garlic Rice
Recipe.assembly_instructions: RANGE-TOP METHOD 1. In stockpot over high heat, bring water to a boil. Add rice, oil, salt, pepper and Roasted Garlic. Stir. Return to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover. 2. Simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 18 to 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. OVEN / STEAMER METHOD 1. Preheat oven to 350 F or preheat steamer. FOR EACH 24 (1/2 cup) SERVINGS: 1. In 2" full steam table pan, place the following: 2 qt boiling water 1 lb + 12 oz rice 2 tbl oil 1 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp pepper 2 oz Roasted Garlic Stir. Cover. 2. Bake or steam until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Blueberry Muffin
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 325 F. 2. Fold blueberries into muffin base. 3. Into each greased or paper-lined *standard muffin-pan cup, portion a level #12 scoop batter. 4. Top each muffin with 1 tsp sugar. 5. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 24 to 27 minutes. 6. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool on racks. 7. Cover. Hold at room temperature for service.
Recipe.special_instructions: When using convection oven, rotate pan(s) one-half turn halfway through baking.

Recipe.name: Chocolate Chip Muffin
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 325 F. 2. Fold chocolate chips into muffin base. 3. Into each greased or paper-lined *standard muffin-pan cup, portion a level #12 scoop batter. 4. Top each muffin with 1 tsp sugar. 5. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 24 to 27 minutes. 6. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool on racks. 7. Cover. Hold at room temperature for service.
Recipe.special_instructions: When using convection oven, rotate pan(s) one-half turn halfway through baking.

Recipe.name: Apple Cinnamon Muffin
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. 2. In a food processor, place apple filling. Pulse until small pieces are formed. 3. Fold apples into muffin base. 4. Into each greased or paper-lined *standard muffin-pan cup, portion a level #12 scoop batter. 5. Top each muffin with 1 tbl Streusel Topping. 6. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 25 to 28 minutes. 7. Cool 10 minutes. Remove from pans. Cool on racks. 8. Cover. Hold at room temperature for service.
Recipe.special_instructions: When using convection oven, rotate pan(s) one-half turn halfway through baking.

Recipe.name: Sausage Mushroom Breakfast Bowl
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. On hot griddle or in saute pan over medium heat, heat 1 tsp oil. 3. Add the following to hot griddle or saute pan: 4-oz spoodle Chick Pea Scramble 2-oz spoodle Sausage 2-oz spoodle mushrooms 1-oz spoodle onion Saute until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. 4. In specified bowl, layer the following: 4-oz spoodle Roasted Potatoes Chick Pea Sausage Vegetable mixture 1 tbl Vegan Cheddar 5. Serve immediately.

Recipe.name: Golden Brown Biscuit & Gravy
Recipe.assembly_instructions: For one serving: 1. On serving plate, layer the following : 1 biscuit 2-oz spoodle gravy 2. Serve immediately.

Recipe.name: Spicy Vegetable Gumbo
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. 2. Combine first amount of water and constarch. Whisk until well blended. 3. On sheet pan(s) coated with cooking spray, spread eggplant in single layer. 4. Bake until tender and browned, 18 to 20 minutes. Set aside. 5. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, celery and garlic. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. 6. Add mushrooms. Saute until mushrooms are tender, 3 to 5 minutes. 7. Add okra, zucchini, green pepper, salt and black pepper. Saute 3 minutes. Stir in base. 8. Add tomato, second amount of water, hot sauce, Cajun seasoning, thyme and eggplant. Bring to a boil. Stir in slurry. Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and boils. Reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes. 9. Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Spanish Rice
Recipe.assembly_instructions: RANGE-TOP METHOD: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add rice. Cook, stirring constantly, until rice is golden, 2 to 4 minutes. 2. Add onion and green pepper. Saute until tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Add garlic. Saute 1 minute. Stir in base. 3. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to boil. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. OVEN / STEAMER METHOD: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F or preheat steamer. FOR EACH 24 (1/2 cup) SERVINGS: 1. In saute pan over medium-high heat, heat 2 tbl oil. Add 1 pound + 3 oz rice. Cook, stirring constantly, until rice is golden, 2 to 4 minutes. 2. Add 6 oz onion and 3 oz green pepper. Saute until tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Add 1 tbl garlic. Saute 1 minute. Stir in 1 oz base. 3. In 2" full steam table pan, place rice-vegetable mixture. 4. Add the following: 1 qt + 2 cup boiling water 1 1/2 cup tomato 3/4 tsp cumin 3/4 tsp salt 3/4 tsp sage 3/4 tsp oregano 1/4 tsp black pepper 1/4 tsp paprika Stir. Cover. 5. Bake or steam until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 6. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Zucchini & Yellow Squash Saute
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In saute pan over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion. Saute until tender-crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. 2. Add zucchini and yellow squash. Saute until tender-crisp, 3 to 5 minutes. Add remaining ingredients. Toss to mix. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Herb Roasted Red Potatoes
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F. 2. Combine all ingredients. Toss to coat. 3. On sheet pan(s) coated with cooking spray, place potatoes in single layer. 4. Bake, turning once, until golden brown and fork-tender, 16 to 22 minutes. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Garlic Broccoli
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In sauce pan over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add garlic. Saute until slightly browned, 20 to 30 seconds. 2. Add broccoli, salt and pepper. Saute until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Fresh Collard Greens
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion. Saute until translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. 2. Add collard greens and salt. Cover. Recipe.special_instructions: IDDSI Level 7

Recipe.name: Cajun Grilled Baked Potato
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 2. Combine all ingredients. Toss to coat. 3. Place potatoes cut side down on griddle. Cook until browned and heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Shawarma Beef
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine all ingredients except beef. Whisk until well blended. 2. Add beef. Toss to coat. 3. Place beef with marinade in covered non-reactive shallow pan(s) or sealable plastic bag(s). Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. DO NOT drain beef. 4. Preheat flat-top griddle to 350 F. 5. Cook beef 2 minutes. Turn beef over. Cook until caramelized, 2 to 3 minutes. 6. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Schug Breakfast Bowl

Recipe.name: Sofrito Black Beans & Rice

Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Stir. Reduce heat. Cover. Simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from heat. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 3. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Confetti Rice
Recipe.assembly_instructions: RANGE-TOP METHOD 1. In stockpot over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion and green and red peppers. Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in base. 2. Add water and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil. Add rice. Stir. Reduce heat. Cover. 3. Simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 18 to 20 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 4. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe. OVEN / STEAMER METHOD 1. Preheat convection oven to 350 F or preheat steamer. FOR EACH 24 (1/2 cup) SERVINGS: 1. In saute pan over medium-high heat, heat 1/4 cup oil. 2. Add the following: 12 oz onion 3 oz green pepper 3 oz red pepper Saute until onion is translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Stir in 1 1/2 oz base. 3. In 2" full steam table pan, place sauteed vegetables. 4. Add the following: 2 qt boiling water 1 lb + 12 oz rice 2 tbl Italian seasoning Stir. Cover. 5. Bake or steam until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed, 30 to 35 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Fluff with fork. 6. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.name: Citrus Vinaigrette
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. In blender or food processor combine all ingredients except oil. Blend until smooth. 2. With blender running, slowly add oil in a thin, steady stream until emulsified. 3. Cover. Keep chilled for service or use as directed in recipe. 4. Whisk before using.

Recipe.name: Garlic Roasted Vegetables
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 400 F. 2. Combine all ingredients. Toss to coat. 3. On sheet pan(s), spread vegetable mixture in single layer. 4. Roast until vegetables are tender-crisp, 10 to 12 minutes. 5. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Combine chicken and marinade. Turn to coat. 2. Place chicken with marinade in covered nonreactive shallow pan(s) or sealable plastic bag(s). Recipe.name: Chicken Tinga
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 325 F. 2. In saute pan over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add chicken. Saute until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes on each side. Remove chicken from pan. 3. To same pan, add garlic and onions. Saute 2 to 3 minutes. Add vinegar to deglaze pan. 4. Add chicken stock, tomato puree, chipotle and spices. 5. Cover tightly with foil. Bake until chicken is fork tender and internal temperature reaches 165 F, 1 TO 1 1/2 hours. 6. Remove chicken from braising sauce, pull into bite sized pieces. 7. Return chicken to sauce. 8 Cover. Keep hot for service.

Recipe.name: Turkey Meatloaf
Recipe.assembly_instructions: 1. Preheat convection oven to 300 F. 2. In a saute pan over medium-high heat, heat oil. Add onion, carrot, pepper and spinach. Saute 3 to 5 minutes. Chill. 3. In a small mixing bowl combine water and egg replacer. 4. In mixer bowl, combine all ingredients. Using paddle attachment, mix on low speed until well blended, 3 to 4 minutes. Do not overmix. FOR EACH 24 SERVINGS: 1. In 2" long half steam table pan coated with cooking spray, firmly press 7 lb turkey mixture. 2. Bake until internal temperature reaches 165 F, convection oven 40 to 45 minutes. 3. Let rest in pan 15 minutes. Remove from pan. 4. Cut each meatloaf into 24 slices (4 ozw). 5. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.

In mixer bowl with whisk attachment, beat potatoes on low speed until no lumps remain, 2 to 3 minutes. 5. Add milk mixture, salt and pepper. Mix until well blended. DO NOT OVERMIX. 6. Cover. Keep hot for service or use as directed in recipe.
